name: inference-advocate
description: Reference implementation of the client side of AIRP (Accountable Inference Reputation Protocol)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @airp/core && npm run build --workspace @airp/store-sqlite && npm run build --workspace @airp/evaluator-local && npm run build --workspace @airp/daemon && npm run build --workspace @airp/demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @airp/core && npm run build --workspace @airp/store-sqlite && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace @airp/core && npm run test --workspace @airp/store-sqlite && npm run test --workspace @airp/evaluator-local && npm run test --workspace @airp/daemon && npm run test --workspace @airp/demo && npm run test --workspace @airp/ui && node --test tools/evaluator-training/*.test.mjs
scripts.doctor: npm run build --workspace @airp/core && npm run build --workspace @airp/store-sqlite && npm run build --workspace @airp/daemon && node packages/daemon/dist/doctor.js
scripts.restart:mocks: npm run kill:mocks && npm run mocks
scripts.restart:daemon: npm run kill:daemon && npm run daemon
